name: simplified-mcp-server
stderr:
Failed to start Simplified MCP Server:
Configuration validation failed:
Missing required environment variables: apiToken

Required environment variables:
- SIMPLIFIED_API_TOKEN: Your Simplified API token

Optional environment variables:
- SIMPLIFIED_API_BASE_URL: API base URL (default: https://api.simplified.com)
- LOG_LEVEL: Logging level (debug|info|warn|error, default: info)
- REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Request timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000)
- RETRY_ATTEMPTS: Number of retry attempts (default: 3)
- RETRY_DELAY: Delay between retries in milliseconds (default: 1000)

Workflow configuration (optional):
- WORKFLOWS_ENABLED: Enable dynamic workflow tools (true|false, default: false)
- WORKFLOW_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL: Auto-refresh interval in ms (0-86400000, default: 0=disabled)
- WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT: Execution timeout in ms (1000-3600000, default: 300000)
- WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS: Max concurrent executions (1-100, default: 10)
- WORKFLOW_FILTER_PATTERNS: Comma-separated workflow name patterns (default: none)
- WORKFLOW_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL: Status polling interval in ms (1000-300000, default: 5000)
- WORKFLOW_RETRY_ATTEMPTS: Retry attempts for failed operations (0-10, default: 3)

Workflow configuration guidelines:
- Set WORKFLOW_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL to 0 to disable automatic refresh
- Use WORKFLOW_FILTER_PATTERNS to limit which workflows are exposed (e.g., "data-*,report-*")
- Minimum WORKFLOW_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL is 1000ms to avoid excessive API calls
- WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT should be set based on your longest-running workflows


Use --help for usage information
